testcase.name: Scenario: Retain an individual large button when ribbon text is turned off: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1781:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain an individual large button when ribbon text is turned off ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open with the full 3D Model ribbon in Normal appearance ✔ And Shell is displayed at Standard button size in the Modify panel ✔ When the user changes the Shell button size to Large ✔ Then Shell appears as a large labeled button ✔ When the user selects Text Off from Ribbon Appearance ✔ Then command labels are hidden and the Modify panel title remains visible ✔ And Shell appears as a large icon without its label ✔ When the user opens the Shell button size submenu ✔ Then Large is checked ✔ When the user selects Standard for Shell ✔ And the user restores Normal ribbon appearance ✔ Then Shell returns to its standard labeled presentation
